en.headline: 405 own commits and 717 automated ones across 13 repos in 30 days
en.teaser: Most work went into the daily-report site, an OpenCode agent sandbox, a skill-management plugin and a translation extension, alongside issue reports to OpenChamber and OpenCode.
en.overview:
The window ran from 2026-10-14 to 2026-11-12 with data for every day. Across all repositories there were 405 own commits plus 717 automated commits, 33 issue actions and no pull requests or reviews.

### Own projects

Most of the work went into the personal site repository `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, where the daily-report pipeline was extended: commit attribution now supports aliases and non-GitHub account emails, a `--force` flag skips the frozen comment-count snapshot, candidate entries are no longer filtered by `updated_at`, and a shared `lib/days.mjs` helper was extracted. A new AI summary of the last 30 days of GitHub activity was added for the home card and a standalone page, and a +08 timezone bug that missed early-morning replies was fixed.

`opencode-agent-sandbox` was built up as a knowledge base, with archived findings on OpenCode V2 distribution, architecture and authentication, Windows path pitfalls, and the oh-my-opencode-slim setup, plus AGENTS.md conventions and corrections to outdated conclusions. `opencode-skill-management` gained the `skill_management` plugin with list, inspect, disable and enable actions, went through rc.0 and rc.1 releases, and shipped v0.2.0, v1.0.0, v1.1.0 and v1.2.0; 1.1.0 switched all actions to a single JSON object with a declared output schema, and 1.2.0 fixed divergent-agent counting and frontmatter boolean parsing.

`sopen-translate` started as an MV3 extension with page translation, then added bilingual rendering, chunk splitting, a circuit breaker, progress reporting, a provider protocol layer with presets and a glossary pipeline, and JSDoc type checking; selection translation was dropped in favour of page translation only. `pixel-logo-toolkit` added automatic text wrapping with overflow protection, a bilingual CLI, an English-first README with a Chinese version, a 40-image command gallery, and a Korean font fix, releasing v0.2.0 and v0.3.0. `opencode-go-model-picker` shipped v1.4.0, v2.0.0, v3.0.0 and v3.0.1, covering shared JSON and proxy helpers, fuller agent discovery, priced accounting with Console calibration, and a large documentation simplification.

Smaller repositories: `dsh-ecosystem-report` got mobile viewport fixes, a single-button theme switcher, visual refinements and a GitHub repository button; `asset-inventory` corrected skill invocation references and released v1.15.4 and v1.15.5; `myBlog` collected OpenChamber screenshots and DSH stats bug images; `dsh-openchamber-plugins` received its first commit porting OpenChamber features.

### Upstream reports

Outside own repositories, 15 issue actions went to `openchamber/openchamber` and 11 to `anomalyco/opencode`, mostly bug reports on storage management, MCP server listing, session retention hints, quote-card navigation, file-view commenting, context-panel breakdowns and browser capture resolution, plus OpenCode Go image-input and subagent model errors. One issue was opened on `microsoft/PowerToys` about a Shortcut Guide NullReferenceException.

highlights.text: Released v1.0.0 as the first stable version, freezing the list, inspect, disable and enable surface for 1.x.
Released v3.0.0, cutting the model-facing documentation from about 104,000 characters to about 8,300.
Released v0.3.0 with automatic CJK-aware text wrapping and proportional font-size fallback on overflow.
Commented on the AI narrative generation failure issue.
Opened and later closed a report that mimo-v2.6-flash and mimo-v2.5 advertise image input but the Go endpoint rejects images.
Opened a bug report that Settings > MCP omits the Console MCP server OpenCode adds at runtime.
Opened a Shortcut Guide report about a NullReferenceException on Hold-Win activation.

zh.headline: 30 天 405 次本人提交、717 次自动提交，覆盖 13 个仓库
zh.teaser: 主要精力放在日报站点、OpenCode 沙箱、技能管理插件和翻译扩展上，同时向 OpenChamber 与 OpenCode 提交了若干问题报告。
zh.overview:
本窗口为 2026-10-14 至 2026-11-12，30 天均有数据。全部仓库合计 405 次本人提交，另有 717 次自动提交，33 次 issue 互动（新开、关闭或评论），没有拉取请求和评审。

### 自有项目

投入最多的是个人站点仓库 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`，日报流水线得到扩展：提交归属支持别名和非 GitHub 账号邮箱，新增 `--force` 跳过评论数快照冻结，候选条目不再按 `updated_at` 过滤，并抽出共享的 `lib/days.mjs` 助手。新增近 30 天 GitHub 活动的 AI 总结，用于首页卡片和独立页面，同时修复了 +08 凌晨漏采回复的问题。

`opencode-agent-sandbox` 被搭建成知识库，归档了 OpenCode V2 分发、架构与认证、Windows 路径坑以及 oh-my-opencode-slim 实测结论，补充了 AGENTS.md 约定并修正过期结论。`opencode-skill-management` 实现了 `skill_management` 插件的 list、inspect、disable、enable 四个动作，经历 rc.0 与 rc.1 后发布 v0.2.0、v1.0.0、v1.1.0 和 v1.2.0；1.1.0 将四个动作统一为单个 JSON 对象并声明输出 schema，1.2.0 修复了跨代理差异误报和 frontmatter 布尔值解析。

`sopen-translate` 从 MV3 页面翻译骨架起步，加入双语渲染、分块切分、熔断、进度上报、带预设与术语表的提供方协议层以及 JSDoc 类型检查，并删去划词翻译只保留页面翻译。`pixel-logo-toolkit` 增加自动折行与溢出保护、中英双语命令行、英文优先加中文版的 README、40 张命令示例画廊和韩语字体修正，发布 v0.2.0 与 v0.3.0。`opencode-go-model-picker` 发布 v1.4.0、v2.0.0、v3.0.0 和 v3.0.1，涵盖共享 JSON 与代理助手、更完整的代理发现、带 Console 校准的计价核算以及大幅文档精简。

其余仓库：`dsh-ecosystem-report` 修复移动端表格与视口适配，把主题切换改为单按钮菜单，做视觉精修并加上 GitHub 仓库按钮；`asset-inventory` 修正技能调用说明并发布 v1.15.4 与 v1.15.5；`myBlog` 收集 OpenChamber 截图和 DSH 统计 bug 截图；`dsh-openchamber-plugins` 收到首个提交，移植 OpenChamber 功能。

### 上游反馈

自有仓库之外，向 `openchamber/openchamber` 提交了 15 次 issue 互动，向 `anomalyco/opencode` 提交了 11 次，多为存储管理、MCP 服务器列表、会话保留提示、引用卡片跳转、文件视图评论、上下文面板占比和浏览器截图分辨率等问题，以及 OpenCode Go 图片输入与子代理模型报错。另在 `microsoft/PowerToys` 开了一个关于快捷指南空引用异常的 issue。

highlights.text: 发布 v1.0.0 首个稳定版，将 list、inspect、disable、enable 的接口在 1.x 内冻结。
发布 v3.0.0，把模型需阅读的文档从约 10.4 万字符压缩到约 8300 字符。
发布 v0.3.0，加入支持中日韩字符的自动折行与溢出时按比例缩小字号。
在 AI 叙述生成失败的 issue 下参与讨论。
报告并随后关闭了 mimo-v2.6-flash 与 mimo-v2.5 声明支持图片输入但 Go 端点一律返回 400 的问题。
报告设置中的 MCP 页面遗漏了 OpenCode 运行时添加的 Console MCP 服务器。
报告快捷指南在 Hold-Win 激活时抛出空引用异常且无任何显示。
